lead.tldr: Aave hits $1T cumulative lending volume first in DeFi with $27B TVL and $83M monthly fees. • Nvidia beats Q4 at $68B revenue forecasts $78B on AI agent adoption surge. • Binance faces US Senate probe over $1.7B Iran Russia sanctions violation claims. • Circle posts $770M Q4 revenue USDC circulation climbs to $75B targeting 40% CAGR. • AI audit exposes high-severity Ethereum bug risking 40% of validators. • Ethereum roadmap eyes 2-second blocks 16-second finality quantum resistance by 2029.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, Aave hits $1T in lending volume as DeFi matures. Nvidia surges on AI adoption while Circle's USDC grows to $75B, but Binance faces US probes over sanctions.

top_signals.title: Aave Notches $1T in Lending Volume, an Industry First
top_signals.summary: Aave has achieved a DeFi industry first by surpassing $1 trillion in cumulative on-chain lending volume, with $27.2 billion in total value locked and $83.3 million in fee revenue over the past 30 days. This milestone underscores Aave's dominance as the largest decentralized lending protocol, holding a 60% market share and over $52 billion in net deposits. For institutional investors, Aave Horizon, an Ethereum-based lending market launched in August, enables borrowing stablecoins against tokenized real-world assets like treasury bonds, offering real-time pledging, 70-75% collateralization rates, and compliance safeguards that boost capital efficiency over traditional finance. Early participants including VanEck, WisdomTree, and Securitize highlight its appeal in bridging TradFi and DeFi liquidity.

top_signals.title: What AI bubble? Nvidia posts record $68 billion quarterly revenue and $78 billion forecast, as Jensen Huang cites ‘skyrocketing’ adoption of agents
top_signals.summary: Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue of $68 billion and forecasts $78 billion, driven by the increasing adoption of AI agents. The company's Q4 and FY 2026 results exceeded expectations across various metrics.

top_signals.title: Whale Loses $8.2M in ARC Liquidation on Lighter as Protocol Contain Losses
top_signals.summary: A crypto whale was liquidated for $8.2 million on Lighter's ARC perpetuals, stemming from a $50 million position. Lighter's system mitigated losses for liquidity providers through segmented liquidity and auto-deleveraging.

top_signals.title: OCC Stablecoin Proposal Targets Yield, Sets Stage for CLARITY Act
top_signals.summary: The OCC has proposed rules to implement the GENIUS Act, which bars yield on payment stablecoins. This proposal also shapes the debate around the CLARITY Act, indicating a move towards stablecoin regulation.

top_signals.title: US Senator Probes Binance Over Alleged Iran, Russia Sanctions Breaches
top_signals.summary: A US Senate investigation is probing Binance for allegedly processing $1.7 billion in transactions linked to Iran and Russia, potentially violating sanctions. Binance denies any wrongdoing.

top_signals.title: US Senator opens probe into Binance over $1.7bn in alleged ties to terrorist groups
top_signals.summary: A US Senator has opened a probe into Binance regarding alleged ties to terrorist groups and the movement of $1.7 billion in illicit funds through its platform. Binance has denied these allegations and reaffirmed its commitment to compliance.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: AI financial platform Rowspace raises $50 million round led by Sequoia to help investment firms take on messy data
top_signals.summary: Rowspace, an AI financial platform, has raised $50 million in a funding round led by Sequoia. The company was founded by former Notion CTO Michael Manapat and former Uber corporate development director Yibo Ling.

top_signals.title: Circle reports $770 million Q4 revenue as USDC circulation reaches $75 billion, targets 40% CAGR for stablecoin
top_signals.summary: Circle reported $770 million in Q4 revenue and reserve income, with USDC circulation reaching $75.3 billion. The company issued guidance targeting a 40% Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) for its stablecoin.

top_signals.title: AI-powered audit uncovers ‘high-severity’ bug in Ethereum software
top_signals.summary: An AI-powered audit uncovered a high-severity bug in an Ethereum client that could have affected nearly 40% of Ethereum validators. The bug was identified by a crypto security firm using AI.

top_signals.title: Tech companies are spending an unprecedented $700 billion this year on AI data centers. Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says we’re not anywhere near the peak
top_signals.summary: Tech companies are projected to spend $700 billion on AI data centers this year. Nvidia's Jensen Huang believes the industry is far from reaching its peak.

top_signals.title: Ethereum Roadmap Targets 2-Second Blocks and Quantum Safety
top_signals.summary: Ethereum's roadmap includes reducing block times to 2 seconds and achieving 16-second finality. The network also aims to implement quantum resistance across seven forks by 2029.

top_signals.title: Exclusive: Startup aiming to break Nvidia’s strangehold on AI data center workloads raises $10.25 million
top_signals.summary: Callosum, a startup developing a system for optimizing AI workloads on different chip types, raised $10.25 million. The company aims to challenge Nvidia's dominance in AI data center workloads.
